title: Moje zadania

requirements.heading: Operacje na bazie danych
requirements.coverage: Unpack pliki2.7z into the candidate folder. Create notatki with Polish collation, import baza.sql, full-screen import.png.

requirements.heading: Operacje na bazie danych
requirements.coverage: MIN(priorytet) for Osoby_id 3; nazwa and priorytet LIKE %na%; imie and nazwa via relation where priorytet 5; imie and COUNT per name via relation. Results verified against criteria R.1.3-R.1.6.

requirements.heading: Przygotowanie grafiki
requirements.coverage: Scale obraz.jpg 480x640 proportionally to height 610 px (width about 458 px).

requirements.heading: Cechy witryny
requirements.coverage: notatki.html, Polish HTML5, encoding, title Planer zadań, styl.css; aside/header/nav/main/footer; image alt notatki, h2 Moje zadania, input placeholder and Dodaj button, six-item ul each with a Wykonane button, footer h3 Notatki: with candidate number.

requirements.heading: Styl CSS witryny internetowej
requirements.coverage: Verdana; aside 20%/610 px; image 100%/610 px; header, nav and footer MediumPurple, white, 80%, 50 px, centred, text-shadow 4px 4px DimGray; nav padding-top 10 px; main Thistle 80% 450 px overflow auto; list buttons; list margins, width, font, border, no markers; li padding, even rows, hover.

requirements.heading: Skrypt
requirements.coverage: Wykonane strikes only its own entry in any order; Dodaj appends the field text with a working, identically styled Wykonane button; meaningful names. No runtime adapter: checked manually.

requirements.heading: UWAGA: po zakończeniu pracy
requirements.coverage: przeglądarka.txt, listed result files and disc hand-in.
